title: Open Text and Image to 3D Models
blurb: Open-weight feed-forward and latent diffusion models that turn a prompt or a picture into a mesh, Gaussians or a radiance field.

title: Text-to-3D Optimization Frameworks
blurb: Score distillation and Gaussian optimization methods and the frameworks that bundle them.

title: Multi-View Diffusion
blurb: Models that synthesize consistent views of an object, the front end of many image-to-3D pipelines.

title: Hosted Generators and APIs
blurb: Managed services for generating 3D assets from text or images, many with developer APIs.

title: Gaussian Splatting and NeRF
blurb: Capture, reconstruction and training tools for radiance fields, splats and neural surfaces.

title: Splat Viewers and Editors
blurb: Web viewers, editors and converters for Gaussian splat files.

title: Auto-Rigging and Animation
blurb: Tools that add skeletons and skin weights to static meshes so they can move.

title: Texture and Materials
blurb: Texture synthesis and differentiable rendering tools for generated geometry.

title: Mesh Cleanup and Retopology
blurb: Libraries and apps for repairing, decimating, remeshing and converting generated meshes.

title: Datasets
blurb: 3D object collections used to train and evaluate generative models.

title: glTF and Pipeline Tooling
blurb: Specs, optimizers, validators, viewers and DCC integrations that take AI output to production.

title: 3D Deep Learning Libraries
blurb: Differentiable geometry and 3D data libraries for building new generative models.

title: Platforms and Integrations
blurb: Products that put generated 3D content to work in applications.
